name: Droid-ify
tagline: A fast, clutter-free way to browse F-Droid
description:
Droid-ify is a modern client for F-Droid, the long-running store of free and open-source Android apps. It is quick, looks good, and makes updates painless.

You can add extra repositories, filter by what an app is allowed to do, and install without any account.
